title.zh: 明确划定达沃省Tagum市镇与Doña Alicia及Compostela市镇之间的行政边界线的法案
title.en: An Act Fixing the Boundary Line Between the Municipality of Tagum and the Municipalities of Doña Alicia and Compostela, Province of Davao
title.orig: An Act Fixing the Boundary Line Between the Municipality of Tagum and the Municipalities of Doña Alicia and Compostela, Province of Davao

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1102_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The boundary line between the municipality of Tagum and Doña Alicia shall be the Dumlan River from the Gulf of Davao to the source of said river and a straight line from said source running northwestward to the concrete monument in the sitio of Libaybay. The boundary line between the municipalities of Tagum and Compostela shall be the Hijo River.
Executive Order No. 596, series of 1953, is amended accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1954.
